description: Structured errors from the last finished geometry run. message is the same text the viewport shows. featureType, featureLabel, and featureIndex identify the failed feature when known. detail is the exception name, a Manifold status, or the kernel message when that text is not already in message. Stack frames and URLs are omitted, and detail is always present on feature_failed: when the kernel adds nothing, it names the helper that threw (move adds how to name the body). Cleared on the next successful run. Feature and kernel failures use code feature_failed.
name: errors
